P_0x001AC8: One of Shu's subordinates, "Saphine the Crimson." A bewitching beauty with perverse tastes. Devotes body and soul to Shu, though he stays cold toward her.
P_0x001BDC: Captain of Langran's Ruzak border guard, lieutenant rank. Courteous, well-mannered. Senior alumnus of Masaki's mentor Zeolute's academy.
P_0x001CA9: Desert-raised surface dweller, pilot of the Elemental Soulgady. Finds his place only through battle, yet seeks peace his own way. Skilled at gathering intel; sometimes acts alone for it.
P_0x001DD3: A Shutedonia soldier. Tomboyish in combat, but very timid outside her Elemental. Shy around others, blushes easily. Has feelings for Rodney.
P_0x001EDA: A Holy Langran soldier. Once thought mediocre, believed to owe his rank to lineage, he proved himself amid war's chaos by minimizing his own losses. Bold, yet a solid tactician.
P_0x001FF1: Kirkus's eldest son, a Holy Langran soldier. Earnest and personable, though timid in daily life. Fell for Lune at first sight. Known as Zash.
P_0x0027F1: A Shtedonias soldier. Solid tactical command, fights by the book. Dutiful, if inflexible.
P_0x00289F: A Shtedonias soldier. Loyal to orders but rarely uses own judgment, so has earned little merit.
